explanation: Removing the reddish, iron-stained stones exposed paler ground beneath. The dry, calm climate has preserved the shallow lines for well over a thousand years.

claims.text: The Nazca Lines were made by removing the dark reddish surface stones to expose the paler ground beneath.
The Nazca Lines were not painted, cut as deep trenches or laid out in white shells.
The surface stones of the Nazca desert are darkened by iron oxide, and the ground beneath is lighter.
The Nazca region's dry, calm climate has preserved the shallow lines for well over a thousand years.
The Nazca Lines include giant figures of a hummingbird and a monkey.
